# Bitsocial React Hooks

> Bitsocial React Hooks is the React hooks and Zustand store package for building Bitsocial clients.

This file is generated by `scripts/generate-llms-files.mjs`. Do not hand-edit it; update the source docs or generator config, then run `yarn llms:generate`.

## Canonical Links

- [Repository](https://github.com/bitsocialnet/bitsocial-react-hooks)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bitsocial/bitsocial-react-hooks)
- [Bitsocial protocol](https://bitsocial.net)
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/bitsocialnet/bitsocial-react-hooks/blob/master/llms-full.txt): Expanded inline corpus generated from the curated source docs.

## Critical Context

- This is a package/library repo, so README.md, src exports, tests, and package manifests are source of truth.
- Hooks are thin selectors around Zustand stores; data flow belongs in stores and protocol clients.
- Generated llms files are compiled context for AI contributors, not API authority.

## Source Of Truth

- Code, tests, package manifests, source docs, and live/runtime evidence when relevant are source of truth.
- This generated file is compiled context for orientation. Verify behavioral claims against source files before editing or concluding.
- Repo-managed AI instructions live in `AGENTS.md` and any directory-specific `AGENTS.md` files.
